title: SongForge Pipeline
description: Issue #18 AC2: live pipeline view -- jobs by state, generation-semaphore utilization, and failure/refund rates.

panels.title: Jobs by state
panels.description: songforge_jobs_in_state{state} -- point-in-time job counts per pipeline state (QUEUED, SUBMITTING, WAITING_FOR_WEBHOOK, INGEST_PENDING, READY, FAILED), scraped from Postgres by metrics_pipeline's scrape-time refresh at every /metrics scrape.

panels.title: Generation-slot utilization
panels.description: songforge_generation_slots_in_use{scope} against songforge_generation_slots_capacity{scope="global"} -- how full the global generation semaphore is (only scope="global" has a meaningful capacity; scope="user" is a sum across however many users currently hold a slot).

panels.title: Terminal failure rate (by path)
panels.description: Terminal job failures broken out by the code path that recorded them, because no single counter captures all of them: dispatch rejections increment songforge_jobs_failed_total, a failure webhook increments songforge_webhooks_received_total{outcome="failed"}, and the watchdog's terminal ingest-escalation increments songforge_watchdog_recovered_total{path="ingest_escalated_failed"}. Charting only jobs_failed_total would read a false zero during webhook- or watchdog-driven incidents. (Ingest failures have their own panel.)

panels.title: Ingest failure rate
panels.description: rate(songforge_ingest_failed_total[5m]) -- audio-ingest failures per second (R2/webhook path).

panels.title: Quota refund rate
panels.description: rate(songforge_quota_refunded_total[5m]) -- quota refunds issued per second when a job fails after consuming a user's daily-quota slot.
